published_ranges._notes: eSUN ePLA-LW (lightweight foaming PLA) TDS v4.0 Nov 2021. Foaming ratio depends on temperature/speed; TDS example: at 270C set extrusion rate ~45%. Above 250C needs an all-metal hotend (PTFE-lined hotends unsuitable). Retraction largely ineffective (stringing normal); vase-mode models recommended. Parts may yellow at high temperature. Diameter not stated in TDS.
